_doc: Equipment drops (spec #33, #109). items: the eligible equipment, ids only (reqLevel, reqJob and stats are read from the canonical Character.wz info in the asset cache): every v83 Character.wz cap, coat, longcoat, pants, shoes, glove, wand (137xxxx) and staff (138xxxx) that is not cash, has reqLevel 0-70 and reqJob 0 or a Magician bit, and that a regular v83 server gave out: dropped by an ordinary mob (id 100000-7999999) in Cosmic's drop_data or sold by a regular NPC shop (Cosmic shopitems, shop id below 9000000, not 1337). This keeps quest, event, GM and boss-only items out (tier B: server data used as facts). Only items whose reqJob allows the character's current job can drop. The item ids live in the per-line fragments equipment_drops/<line>.json (common = reqJob 0 armour, then one file per job line; wands and staves with their line), concatenated and sorted ascending by DataRepo.load_all; a duplicate id is an error (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4).
_rules: below/above: an item can drop when its reqLevel is within [level - below, level + above] (owner, tier C). falloff: weight = 1 / (1 + falloff x |reqLevel - level|), so nearer items are likelier (tier C). chance: per ordinary kill, sized once from an estimate (tier C): a full Henesys clear is about 3,300 kills and the ticket wants about 8-12 items a round including the boss drops, so about 7 ordinary drops is 0.002 per kill (v83 mobs gave equipment on 0.7-2% of kills, but a round has thousands of kills). boss_drops: items each scheduled boss death drops, no chance roll (tier C: the ticket says exactly one). boss_top: a boss item comes from reqLevel [level + above - boss_top, level + above] (the top of the window; the highest reqLevel in the window when nothing is that high; the nearest eligible item when the window is empty).
